import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final double PI = 3.1415926535897932384626433832795028841971693992;
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long p = sc.nextLong();
        long k = sc.nextLong();

        if (k == 0) {
            System.out.println(pow(p, p - 1));
            return;
        }
        if (k == 1) {
            System.out.println(pow(p, p));
            return;
        }

        long order = 1;
        long a = k;
        while (a != 1) {
            a = (a * k) % p;
            order++;
        }
        System.out.println(pow(p, (p - 1) / order));
    }

    static long pow(long base, long exp) {
        long res = 1;
        long a = base % MOD;
        long p = exp;
        while (p > 0) {
            if ((p & 1) == 1) {
                res = (res * a) % MOD;
            }
            a = (a * a) % MOD;
            p >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }
}
